name: blockout-to-real
description: Turn any grey 3D scene (a .blend, a mesh file, a JSON scene spec or an idea) into the same scene with ordinary PBR materials and fitted lights: a photoreal target of one fixed view, albedo, roughness and normals back-projected into each object's own UV textures, lights fitted through Cycles, and a residual loop scored with LPIPS that turns a fresh reviewer's list into geometry edits. Ends in an editable, relightable .blend.
